{{Top|leg}}
A '''supercomputer''' was an advanced computer that was incredibly fast at calculating. The [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] had constructed these types of computers, and one was present at the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] fortress on [[Taral V]].
